response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong TypeScript/Node.js and general software craftsmanship skills, but has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, AI accelerator architecture, GPU workload analysis, or deep-learning performance optimization, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. The background is fundamentally misaligned with the hardware/performance-architecture focus of the position.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across multiple domains
Strong track record of open-source contributions and technical leadership/mentoring
concerns: No SoC, IP modeling, or chip design experience evident anywhere in resume
No AI/deep-learning workload optimization, GPU architecture, or accelerator hardware background
Career trajectory is entirely web/full-stack/application software, not systems/hardware performance engineering

key_factors.factor: Lack of SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator/GPU/deep-learning performance optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience level
